COMPLEXITIES IN THE MANAGEMENT AND OUTCOME OF SIGNIFICANT ANEMIA "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":" BACKGROUND:\u003Cdiv\u003E\"Understanding anemia’s varied and complex etiology is crucial for developing effective interventions that address the context-specific causes of anemia.\"  \"While iron deficiency ID remains a primary cause in many settings, the proportion of anemic individuals with ID varies by contextual factors, and poor iron nutrition cannot be assumed to be the primary cause in all cases. Given the complex etiology of anemia, the extent to which ID accounts for the anemia burden continues to be investigated.\"\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAIM\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;To navigate clinical complexity in patients with anemia and optimize their management toward reducing diagnostic and therapeutic uncertainty along with improvement in their anemia outcomes.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOBJECTIVES\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• To assess various clinical and investigational characteristics of patients with anemia in relation to their clinical complexity and outcomes. • To analyse patient outcomes based on morbidity (physical, social \u0026amp; psychological limitations)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPATIENTS AND METHOD\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E PLACE OF STUDY: Department of General medicine , Kamineni Institute of Medical Sciences, Narketpally.  STUDY PERIOD: November 2022-October 2024  STUDY DESIGN : Non experimental (Observational) qualitative Prospective Study  SAMPLE SIZE: 50 patients\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EINCLUSION CRITERIA:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnemia patients of any gender above or equal to 18yrs of age at the time of presentation. • Patients presenting with a combination of anemia and complex etiological possibilities where the diagnosis remains uncertain and treatment remains empirical.  For example a typical patient to be included may have low hemoglobin and low serum ferritin with no history of blood loss or dietary indiscretions or a patient with low hemoglobin and high serum ferritin likely to have both iron deficiency as well as chronic\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EEXCLUSION CRITERIA:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatients below 18 years of age (minors)  2.Patients not capable of giving consent (mentally-ill patients)  3.Patients not willing to participate in study (nonconsenting patients)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EETHICAL PERMISSION AND CONSENT\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Enstitutional ethical committee clearance will be obtained from ethical committee of Kamineni Institute of Medical Sciences prior to start of study.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECONSENT FORM\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI resident of have been explained about my condition by\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ethe physician and also the nature and purpose of this study. My questions about the above\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehave been answered in satisfactory manner.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI HAVE READ AND UNDERSTOOD THIS DOCUMENT AND I VOLUNTEER TO BE A\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPART OF THIS STUDY.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI NOT BEING FULLY CONVERSANT IN ENGLISH THE CONTENTS OF THIS\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDOCUMENT WERE EXPLAINED TO ME IN TELUGU\/HINDI.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI HEREBY GIVE MY CONSENT.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient’s signature\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETime\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eఅ\"మతి పత్రము\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eనేను\/మేము అన' రో)యొక్క బంధువులం రో) సంబంధిత సమాచార పత్రము\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eఅందించిన సమాచారాన్ని చదివి అర్థం చేసుకున్నాను మరియునేను
